task.description: WF-03 Step 6: Release validation for ISS-0206 fix in src/definition/store.zig::rowToDefinition. The fix replaces unbuffered partial construction with a RowFields-then-rowToDefinitionFromFields pattern: parses all 11 fields into a single allocator-owning struct, registers each errdefer immediately after its try, and assembles the Definition{...} literal last so fallible calls cannot leak. Pattern is derived from the proven ISS-0132 parseGraphJson fix (similar errdefer-in-block-A).
